source: Spirit Walker
Cast commune with nature as a ritual; the answer arrives as a spirit beast.
Totemic Attunement

While raging: Bear gives each hostile creature within 5 feet of you disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you or another with this feature; Eagle gives you a flying speed equal to your walking speed, though you fall if you end your turn in the air with nothing holding you up; Elk lets you pass through a Large or smaller creature's space as a bonus action, and it is knocked prone and takes 1d12 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage unless it succeeds on a Strength save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier); Tiger lets you make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action after moving at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or smaller target; Wolf lets you knock a Large or smaller creature prone as a bonus action when you hit it with a melee weapon attack.
Ancestral spirits answer this barbarian's rage and shield the people fighting beside them.
Ancestral Protectors

While raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you until the start of your next turn or until your rage ends, and when it hits a creature other than you, that creature has resistance to the attack's damage.
Spirit Shield
While raging, a reaction reduces damage to an ally you can see within 30 feet by 2d6, rising to 3d6 at 10th level and 4d6 at 14th.
Consult the Spirits
Cast augury or clairvoyance once per short or long rest, using Wisdom, without a slot or components.
Vengeful Ancestors
Damage prevented by Spirit Shield is dealt straight back to the attacker as force damage.
Rage manifests as a 10-foot aura of desert heat, arctic cold, or sea storm.
Storm Aura

Choose an environment (desert, sea or tundra), changed when you gain a barbarian level. When you enter your rage its 10-foot aura wakes, and on each later turn of the rage a bonus action wakes it again. Desert: each other creature in it takes 2 fire damage (3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th). Sea: one creature of your choice in it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 lightning damage, half on a success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th). Tundra: each creature of your choice in it gains 2 temporary hit points (rising with the desert's numbers). Its save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
Storm Soul

A lasting boon of your environment. Desert: you resist fire damage, shrug off extreme heat, and can set an unattended flammable object alight with a touch as an action. Sea: you resist lightning damage, breathe underwater and gain a 30-foot swimming speed. Tundra: you resist cold damage, shrug off extreme cold, and can freeze a 5-foot cube of water with a touch as an action.
Shielding Storm
Every ally inside your Storm Aura shares your Storm Soul damage resistance.
Raging Storm

Your aura's environment sharpens. Desert: right after a creature in the aura hits you, a reaction makes it save on Dexterity or take fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: when you hit a creature in the aura, a reaction makes it save on Strength or be knocked prone. Tundra: whenever the aura's effect activates, one creature you can see in it saves on Strength or has its speed reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.
A divine champion whose fury is holy, and who death itself has trouble keeping.
Divine Fury
The first creature you hit each turn while raging takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level radiant or necrotic damage.
Warrior of the Gods
A spell that restores you to life needs no material component.
Fanatical Focus
Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new result.
Zealous Presence
A bonus action, once per long rest, grants up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn.
Rage Beyond Death

While you rage, having 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious. You still make death saving throws and suffer the usual effects of taking damage at 0 hit points, but if you would die from failed death saves you don't die until your rage ends, and then only if you still have 0 hit points.
Rage grows weapons out of the barbarian's own body: claws, a tail, savage teeth.
Form of the Beast

When you enter your rage, grow one natural weapon until it ends, a melee weapon that uses Strength: Bite (1d8 piercing; once on each of your turns, a bite that hits while you have less than half your hit points restores hit points equal to your proficiency bonus), Claws (1d6 slashing, one in each hand; once on each of your turns, attacking with a claw in the Attack action lets you make one more claw attack) or Tail (1d8 piercing with a 10-foot reach; when a creature you can see within 10 feet hits you, a reaction adds 1d8 to your AC against that attack).
Bestial Soul
Your natural weapons count as magical, and you can adapt to swim, climb or jump after each rest.
